You will install the library and check required extensions.

Requirements

  • PHP ≥ 8.0 (CI tests 8.0–8.5)
  • ext-json, ext-hash
  • ext-sodium required for aead/both and Ed25519
  • Optional: ext-curl, PSR-18, PSR-16, cloud KMS SDKs

Check on your machine

bash
php -v
php -m | grep sodium

Install with Composer

bash
composer require sk8dvlpr/securepayload

On success, the package appears under vendor/sk8dvlpr/securepayload.

✓
Tip

Hybrid ML-DSA needs a pqSigner from your app — it is not bundled.
